Name: How to Get a Girlfriend
Overview:
How to Get a Girlfriend consists of a series of questions aimed at measuring the user's knowledge about how to succeed with girls. For each question, there are four possible answers; only one is correct. Each answer is followed by a comment, that sets out why the right answer is so, and, for some questions, explains why the other ones are wrong.

A question, for instance, says: «A girl you like comes up to you and says she isn't interested in being with you. What do you do?». And available answers are:

Ask her why she thinks that and try to convince her otherwise.
Splash her with your drink.
Cut your losses and move on.
Act sad and start crying to make her pity you.
Questions finished, the game invites to restart or «go out and try your new moves!».
